narrative.overview: ConnLab should feel like a disciplined lab ledger with modern workbench controls. It is not a landing page, not a developer console, and not an ERP menu maze. The interface should disappear into the work: import, review, precheck, register, preview, generate.
keyCharacteristics: Left-navigation product shell, not a centered hero page
Project-first workflow with visible status and next action
Dense but readable tables, forms, and issue panels
Restrained blue, cyan, green, warning, and danger state colors
Familiar controls with consistent hover, focus, disabled, and error states

rules.name: The State Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved for current selection, next action, and semantic state. Decorative color blocks are prohibited.

rules.name: The No Display Font Rule
rules.body: Product labels, buttons, tables, and workflow steps use the same sans family. Decorative display type is prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Use borders and background tone before shadow.

dos: Do use a left-navigation app shell with a top context bar.
Do make every page answer current state, blocker, and next action.
Do use tables or dense rows for project lists.
Do show precheck issues as business-readable cards.
donts: Don't expose Matrix, Report, AI review, permissions, or installer work as active UI.
Don't use a landing-page hero for workflow screens.
Don't create a toolbox page full of disconnected buttons.
Don't show raw backend errors as final user guidance.
